interaction: A traffic light turns green on load and a little learner car drives a winding SVG road down the page as you scroll (it parks at each stop with reduced motion); the booking flow lets you choose a package, pickup suburb and a free slot in next week's grid, then shows a summary and a demo toast — all in English or 中文.
notes: On phones the road becomes a straight lane down the left edge. Availability is generated deterministically from the date; logbook information is general and labelled as such.
